title: Head of Operations
description:
Overview

We’re a fast-paced team. As a business, we help U.S. companies grow top-tier offshore talent across sales, marketing, and operations. We’re scaling rapidly and are looking for a Head of Operations to help us move smarter, scale faster, and prepare for the next phase of growth. This is a high-impact role, and you’ll be reporting directly to our CEO.

In this role, you’ll be in charge of day-to-day operational oversight , managing the teams in charge of recruiting ops, tracking operational metrics, AR/AP and bookkeeping, as well as strategic financial leadership alongside a bookkeeping team and a fractional CFO. This is perfect for someone who’s excelled in an ops role at a B2B company , has touched finance, and is now ready to lead company-wide operations .

The Role

You’ll serve as a key partner to the CEO, owning our operational health while ensuring that our finances run smoothly. You’ll manage a team of 5 direct reports, who manage another 15. Your goal is to help leadership make smarter decisions through data, planning, and streamlined processes. This is a job for someone who wants to one day become a COO , whether here or elsewhere.

What You’ll Do

  • Oversee Recruiting operations, driving process efficiency and alignment with account management.
  • Lead project management for process improvements, tool rollouts, and automation initiatives.
  • Develop, document, and improve internal processes across teams to support efficient, scalable growth.
  • Build and maintain business dashboards to track recruiting, financial, and operational KPIs.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales and Marketing to align on growth strategy, forecasting, and operational capacity.
  • Automate and streamline workflows using Zapier, HubSpot, ClickUp, and Slack.

Financial Leadership

  • Own budgeting and forecasting, building models that support growth, profitability, and efficiency.
  • Manage the Bookkeeping and AR/AP team, ensuring accurate invoicing, collections, and clean financials.
  • Lead pricing strategy, evaluating cost structures, market trends, and margin opportunities — collaborating with a fractional CFO, when needed.
  • Analyze cost drivers and ROI across teams and tools; recommend optimizations to improve margins.
  • Review and interpret monthly financials (bookkeeping handled by your team); deliver insights to leadership.
  • Build dashboards in Google Sheets/Excel for real-time visibility into revenue, expenses, and performance.

Who You Are

  • 5-8 years of experience with at least 3 years in a B2B company where you managed an operations team, with at least 5 direct reports and 10 indirect reports.
  • At least 2 years of experience working in or touching finance.
  • Proficient in financial modeling and forecasting; expert-level in Google Sheets/Excel.
  • Tech-savvy — you’ve worked with HubSpot, ClickUp/Asana, Zapier, and similar tools.
  • A strategic thinker and hands-on doer — you see the big picture but aren’t afraid to get into the weeds.
  • Excellent communicator who can present operational and financial insights clearly and concisely.
  • You’ve worked in recruiting/staffing, SaaS or b2b services.
  • You’re excited to take a cognitive exam in math, verbal, and attention to detail.
  • You speak quickly. This is non-negotiable.

Why You’ll Love It Here

  • Fully remote, fast-paced, and innovative team.
  • Own both operations and finance in a growing, forward-thinking company.
  • Clear path to COO for the right person.
  • Autonomy to lead strategy, streamline systems, and make a real impact.
  • A collaborative, supportive culture where your leadership shapes our path.
  • Work with very fast people every single day.

Do you want to collaborate closely with software engineers, product managers, and researchers to design, implement, and evaluate models and algorithms that continuously adapt and improve based on user interactions and feedback? Do you want to leverage advanced machine learning and information retrieval to predict and optimize memory content selection, representation, and lifecycle management?

The Substrate Core Substrate team powers the infrastructure that underpins Microsoft 365’s most critical services and Copilot. We are a high-impact, forward-looking team focused on building intelligent, scalable, and cost-efficient platforms that enable Microsoft to deliver world-class productivity experiences to billions of users. Our mission is to drive operational excellence and innovation across the M365 fleet by leveraging AI, automation, and deep platform integration.

Your core mission will be to deliver exciting innovation in Microsoft Copilot. Microsoft Copilot is revolutionizing how people work and have created an unprecedented opportunity to advance the state-of-the-art in a way that benefits millions of people.

More About Your Responsibilities

We are seeking candidates with research skills and the desire to pursue the cutting edge in model development that pushes technological boundaries. We are looking for candidates with interest and experience in language model training, large language model evaluation, and quality assessment. In particular we would like a candidate that has a passion for understanding what makes an AI solution work and how to measure its performance. We are looking for candidates who are creative, self-driven, curious, people-oriented and comfortable defining a path through ambiguity towards high-level goals. The successful applicants will collaborate closely with people across Microsoft’s product teams and Microsoft Research to see their ideas realized in products and services that are used worldwide, as well as to contribute back to the scientific community and beyond (e.g. via presentations, publications, media interviews, and similar). Come to define, design, and deliver what enterprise cloud productivity means.

As a Data Scientist , you will help transform how Copilot features are evaluated and improved. Your team will deliver end-to-end experimentation, evaluation, and insights to Copilot engineers, PMs, and fellow scientists. You’ll work on the data generation platform that creates algorithms and ML pipelines for simulating user actions and datasets that reflect real-world usage and user preferences and develop metrics that go beyond accuracy – capturing nuance, intent, and satisfaction. You’ll work on scalable pipelines that support offline evaluations for Copilot Search, BizChat, Connectors, and Agents (DAs). This opportunity will allow you to dive deep into Copilot technologies, shape how AI quality is measured at scale, build critical skills in the AI-era, and rapidly grow your career.

By applying to this position, you will be considered for multiple similar positions within our organization for an invitation-only virtual interview day. Position specifics, including hiring team, location, and position details, will be determined following the interview process.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and evaluate ML models using prepared datasets, customer feedback, and novel training/fine-tuning algorithms for language models.
  • Write production-quality code, apply debugging best practices, and stay current with industry trends.
  • Drive customer-centric solutions by aligning with business goals and managing stakeholder expectations.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to define success metrics and improve AI quality at scale.
  • Lead research projects that yield new algorithms, tools, or insights solving open problems.
  • Analyze evaluation outputs to identify gaps in coverage, quality, and usability.
  • Design experiments, define metrics, and develop ML pipelines for encoder-decoder and cross-encoder models, semantic search, and user intent understanding.
  • Work with large-scale data while championing privacy and compliance.
  • Engage with customers and internal teams to identify pain points and drive impactful improvements.
  • Stay engaged with the latest research and foster a strong applied science culture. Publishing is encouraged.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, or related field.
  • 4+ years of experience in predictive analytics, statistics, or research.
  • Experience with synthetic data generation and data management for evaluation/training.
  • At least one year of experience publishing patents or peer-reviewed papers.
  • Deep motivation for user-centric AI and interest in human cognition, memory, and AI.
  • Global collaboration is integral to our work at Microsoft, and proficiency in English is essential for effective communication in this role.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, or related field.
  • Experience with large-scale embedding models and transformer architectures.
  • Familiarity with reinforcement learning and distributed computing platforms (e.g., Heron, AML, Euclid).
  • Proficient analytical skills and experience with telemetry and performance metrics.
  • DevOps experience and cloud services knowledge (Azure preferred).
  • Agile development experience and a structured approach to software design.

Interpersonal Skills

  • Growth mindset with resilience and a passion for learning.
  • Commitment to diversity, inclusion, and authentic collaboration.
  • Effective communication skills with the ability to engage diverse audiences.
  • Ownership mindset with the ability to deliver results and manage expectations.

description:
Buscamos um Analista de Performance Operacional para apoiar diretamente os gestores gerais do grupo nas nossas operações (5 hamburguerias, um restaurante italiano, um boteco e um bar de alta coquetelaria) com gestão centralizada e estratégica nas rotinas críticas da operação, com entregas diárias e semanais de controle, análise e suporte à tomada de decisão.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Relatório de performance consolidado e por unidade, com análises incluindo:

  • Acompanhamento da efetividade de ações promocionais
  • Criação de painéis de performance e alertas automáticos (com Excel e sistemas)

Requisitos

  • Formação completa em Administração ou Ciências Contábeis
  • Experiência comprovada de no mínimo 1 ano em rotinas financeiras, operacionais ou controladoria (em empresas do setor alimentício, varejo ou serviços)
  • Excel avançado (testado em entrevista)
  • Experiência com sistemas ERP, controle de estoque, financeiro e retaguarda
  • Experiência em DRE, DFC, conciliação bancária, fluxo de caixa
  • Capacidade de gerar e apresentar relatórios com clareza
  • Desejável conhecimento de ficha técnica e rotinas de PCP

  • Altíssimo nível de comprometimento com entrega de rotina; não pode perder prazos ou precisar ser cobrado
  • Perfil extremamente analítico e organizado, com raciocínio lógico forte
  • Perfil executor: resolve, cruza dados, antecipa problemas e entrega sem necessidade de supervisão constante
  • Capacidade de autogestão e foco em resultado
  • Vontade de crescer dentro do grupo, apoiando decisões de alto impacto

title: SUPERVISOR DE PRESTAÇÃO DE CONTAS
description:
Sobre a Empresa

A Fundação José Silveira (FJS) é uma instituição privada, sem fins lucrativos, com quase nove décadas de história. Reconhecida como de utilidade pública, atua fortemente nas áreas de saúde, ensino, pesquisa e projetos socioambientais , sempre pautada pelo compromisso social e pela transparência na gestão de recursos públicos.

Com sede em Salvador e atuação em diversas regiões do Estado, a FJS é referência no Terceiro Setor , conduzindo contratos em parceria com órgãos públicos das esferas municipal, estadual e federal.

Cultura e Equipe

A cultura organizacional é guiada por valores como ética, responsabilidade social, inovação e excelência em gestão . A Fundação valoriza o trabalho colaborativo, estimulando a troca de conhecimento entre diferentes áreas, a capacitação contínua e o fortalecimento das equipes.

Na Controladoria, o ambiente é dinâmico e desafiador, reunindo profissionais comprometidos com a conformidade contábil e legal e com a missão institucional da FJS. A área de Prestação de Contas atua como elo estratégico entre contabilidade, faturamento, jurídico e setores técnicos, assegurando a rastreabilidade e a integridade das informações.

Sobre a Vaga

Garantir conformidade na aplicação e prestação de contas dos recursos públicos, atendendo às exigências legais, contratuais e dos órgãos fiscalizadores.

Supervisionar e orientar a equipe , assegurando qualidade, prazos e integridade das informações.

Coordenar processos contábeis e financeiros , incluindo encerramento do exercício e publicação das demonstrações.

Atuar de forma estratégica , elaborando relatórios gerenciais, indicadores e apoiando a tomada de decisão.

Representar a área em auditorias , prestando esclarecimentos técnicos.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Supervisionar a equipe responsável pela elaboração e análise das prestações de contas financeiras e técnicas, assegurando conformidade com os contratos de gestão, convênios, termos de colaboração e demais instrumentos firmados com entes públicos das esferas municipal, estadual e federal.
  • Coordenar a organização, validação e arquivamento da documentação comprobatória da aplicação dos recursos públicos (notas fiscais, recibos, folhas de pagamento, extratos bancários, relatórios de execução e comprovantes de recolhimento de encargos sociais, etc.).
  • Acompanhar a escrituração e análise dos registros contábeis relacionados às prestações de contas, assegurando a consistência das informações lançadas e a correta vinculação às rubricas contratuais.
  • Coordenar os processos de encerramento do exercício contábil e garantir a adequada elaboração e publicação das demonstrações contábeis dos contratos, em conformidade com as normas vigentes e exigências contratuais e legais.
  • Controlar os prazos de entrega das prestações de contas e relatórios contábeis, garantindo atendimento às cláusulas contratuais e legislações aplicáveis.
  • Atuar como elo entre a área de prestação de contas e os setores de contabilidade, faturamento, suprimentos, jurídico e assistência, assegurando a rastreabilidade e integridade dos dados.
  • Fornecer orientação técnica à equipe e às unidades executoras quanto à correta aplicação dos recursos públicos e ao atendimento das demandas dos órgãos fiscalizadores.
  • Elaborar e apresentar relatórios gerenciais e indicadores de desempenho, oferecendo suporte à tomada de decisão estratégica e à melhoria contínua dos processos de controle institucional.
  • Representar a área perante auditorias internas e externas, prestando esclarecimentos técnicos sempre que necessário.
  • Manter-se atualizado e disseminar à equipe a legislação e normas aplicáveis ao Terceiro Setor e à gestão de recursos públicos.

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Formação acadêmica: Bacharelado em Ciências Contábeis.
  • Experiência: Vivência prévia em supervisão ou coordenação de equipes; experiência mínima de 3 a 5 anos em rotinas contábeis e prestação de contas, preferencialmente no Terceiro Setor ou em instituições que atuem em parcerias com o poder público.

title: Head of Customer Success and Implementation
description:
About Pear Suite

Pear Suite is a mission-driven healthcare technology company transforming how community-based care is delivered. Our platform empowers community health workers, doulas, and other frontline providers with tools to coordinate care, track outcomes, and improve health equity. We partner with organizations serving Medicaid and Medicare populations, delivering social and preventive care at scale.

Why Pear Suite?

We're a mission-driven team committed to health equity and innovation in community-based care. You'll thrive here if you're eager to take initiative, value autonomy, and enjoy building structure where none exists. Join us to build scalable, human-centered technology that empowers frontline workers and improves lives across the U.S.

About the role

We\'re seeking a Head of Customer Success and Implementation to lead how we deliver, support, and grow our customer partnerships. You will own the full customer journey—from onboarding and implementation to adoption, retention, and expansion. This is both a strategic and hands-on role: you\'ll design scalable processes, lead customer-facing teams, and directly engage with our most important partners to ensure they achieve measurable impact with Pear Suite.

What you\'ll do

  • Lead the Customer Success and Implementation functions, building the strategy, playbooks, and processes for a rapidly scaling healthcare SaaS platform.
  • Oversee new customer onboarding and implementation projects, ensuring timely and successful go-lives.
  • Drive adoption, engagement, and measurable outcomes across Pear Suite\'s customer base.
  • Establish KPIs for retention, expansion, NPS, and time-to-value.
  • Serve as executive sponsor for key customers, building strong, trust-based relationships with senior leaders at partner organizations.
  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Sales to ensure customer feedback informs roadmap and delivery.
  • Build and mentor a high-performing Customer Success and Implementation team, fostering career growth and development.
  • Develop scalable processes, tools, and systems to support a growing, diverse customer base.
  • Provide regular reporting and insights to the executive team and Board on customer health, retention, and revenue impact.
  • Manage escalations and ensure quick, empathetic resolution of customer issues.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of progressive experience in Customer Success, Implementation, or related functions, ideally in SaaS.
  • At least 3 years of leadership experience managing customer-facing teams in healthcare or healthtech or community based groups.
  • Demonstrated success in scaling customer success/implementation functions in a high-growth startup.
  • Strong background in implementation project management, with a proven ability to deliver on time and within scope.
  • Deep knowledge of SaaS metrics (retention, NRR, churn, time-to-value, etc.) and how to improve them.
  • Experience supporting Medicaid/Medicare-focused organizations, provider groups, or community-based organizations strongly preferred.
  • Ability to balance strategic leadership with hands-on execution.
  • Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to make complex workflows and data clear to diverse stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to build and maintain strong executive-level relationships with customers.
  • Comfort navigating ambiguity, creating structure, and driving outcomes in fast-changing environments.
  • Experience with CRM, CS, and project management tools (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot, Gainsight, Asana, etc.).
  • MBA, PMP, or similar credentials are a plus.

What we offer

  • The compensation range for this position is $140,000-$180,000
  • A mission driven culture that values innovation, collaboration and growth
  • Fully Remote
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • Health and Wellness Stipend
  • Tech Stipend
  • Co-working Stipend

title: Pessoa Supervisora de Logística
description:
Sobre a empresa

Há mais de 120 anos, a FTD Educação tem como missão transformar o futuro por meio da Educação, pensando além e inspirando a descoberta, a escolha, a liberdade e a cidadania. Somos reconhecidos como uma empresa inovadora, parceira, flexível e humana. Nossa proposta é integrada para escolas, alunos, professores e sociedade e conta com materiais didáticos e de literatura; soluções educacionais; novas tecnologias; obras e serviços que envolvem a família na busca por uma educação completa. E tudo isso feito por profissionais engajados em nossa missão. Imagina trabalhar em um lugar que ajuda a mudar nossa sociedade por meio da educação todos os dias?

Então #VempraFTD e faça parte desse time apaixonado pela educação e que conta com muitos benefícios e um ambiente único de trabalho, com muita colaboração e parceria. FTD EDUCAÇÃO “Conectamos Histórias. Construímos Futuros”.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Estamos em busca de um(a) Supervisor(a) de logística para atuar com foco em gestão de três filiais, garantindo o bom funcionamento das operações logísticas, gestão de estoque e desenvolvimento de equipe. Essa pessoa fará a supervisão das atividades de recebimento, armazenagem, expedição e conferência de cargas, assegurando acuracidade e produtividade dos processos.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Planejar, organizar e controlar as atividades logísticas das três filiais, garantindo correta movimentação e armazenagem dos materiais;
  • Realizar inventários com foco em acuracidade de estoque e análise de divergências;
  • Supervisionar o recebimento, expedição e conferência de cargas, incluindo cenários em que não houver doca disponível;
  • Garantir a acuracidade e controle de estoque, evitando perdas e assegurando armazenagem adequada;
  • Elaborar relatórios periódicos de desempenho logístico, propondo melhorias e soluções para gargalos identificados;
  • Acompanhar e analisar indicadores de produtividade, conferência e performance da operação;
  • Liderar, treinar e motivar a equipe de logística, distribuindo tarefas e acompanhando resultados;
  • Cumprir e fazer cumprir normas de saúde, segurança do trabalho e qualidade;
  • Sugerir melhorias contínuas nos processos logísticos e operacionais;
  • Atuar em parceria com as áreas de apoio para garantir eficiência das operações.

Requisitos e qualificações

Formação
Graduação completa em Logística ou áreas correlatas.

Necessário

  • Vivência robusta em operações logísticas (recebimento, armazenagem, expedição, conferência de cargas e inventário);
  • Vivência com gestão de estoque, controle de perdas e indicadores de performance;
  • Vivência em liderança de equipes, com foco em treinamento, motivação e desenvolvimento;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens frequentes;
  • CNH categoria B ativa;
  • Conhecimento em sistemas integrados de gestão (noção de TOTVS será um diferencial).

Diferenciais

  • Vivência prévia na gestão logística de mais de uma filial;
  • Vivência no setor educacional;

Informações adicionais

Quais benefícios nós oferecemos?

  • Vale Refeição ou Vale Alimentação (Pluxee);
  • Vale transporte;

Saúde

  • Seguro de Vida - MetLife;
  • Plano de Saúde - Central Nacional Unimed;
  • Telemedicina CNU - Atendimento médico online ou telefônico;
  • Plano Odontológico - Odontoprev;
  • Zenklub: Cuide sua saúde mental!
  • Wellhub: foco em qualidade de vida, saúde e bem-estar com academias, yoga, pilates e dança;

Benefícios Institucionais, Assistenciais e Financeiros

  • Programa Cuidado Integral (doenças crônicas).
  • Programa Conte Comigo – orientação financeira e consultoria previdenciária;
  • Programa Família Acolhida: Gestação e Adoção;
  • Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida;
  • Programa Indique um amigo;

  • Auxílio Creche - para as mamães;

Incentivo para Educação

Trabalhamos com um time 100% remoto, valorizando a flexibilidade, a organização e o compromisso com resultados. Sobre a oportunidade: Estamos buscando um (a) Head Comercial para assumir o desafio de iniciar do zero e escalar nosso time de vendas. No começo, será mão na massa: criar indicadores, processos, cronogramas, estruturação de processos comerciais e automações. Requisitos obrigatórios: Experiência prática em vendas consultivas B2B e/ou B2C. Capacidade comprovada de definir e acompanhar indicadores comerciais. Boa comunicação, resiliência e foco em resultados. Desejável: Experiência anterior como coordenador(a), líder ou head comercial. Experiência com vendas para segmentos como advocacia, despachantes ou seguros. Conhecimento em ferramentas de CRM e automação. Local: Trabalho 100% remoto.

Sobre Nós

Já pensou em fazer parte de uma empresa que é referência em TI, impulsionando a inovação e transformando o mercado desde 2001?

Venha para a Qualificar TI!

Na Qualificar TI, somos especialistas em Governança de Dados, Gerenciamento de Projetos, Transformação Digital e Outsourcing. Oferecemos soluções estratégicas e as melhores práticas para atender às necessidades técnicas de nossos clientes.

O Que Buscamos

Procuramos gente apaixonada por tecnologia, que quer crescer e se desenvolver num ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo. Queremos pessoas que:

  • Tenham perfil de Transformação Digital e sejam inovadoras.

  • Valorizem o compartilhamento de experiências e o trabalho em equipe.

  • Desenvolvimento Contínuo : Oferecemos um espaço onde a aprendizagem e o desenvolvimento são contínuos, proporcionando a você as ferramentas e o suporte necessários para crescer profissionalmente.
  • Impacto Real: Contribua para projetos que realmente fazem a diferença para nossos clientes, utilizando as melhores práticas e soluções tecnológicas.

Se identificou? Então, venha fazer parte do nosso time!

Sobre a oportunidade

Responsável por coordenar a operação da infraestrutura de TIC, envolvendo servidores, redes, bancos de dados e segurança. A atuação exige visão estratégica, capacidade de liderança técnica e foco em alta disponibilidade e continuidade dos serviços.

Atividades principais

  • Supervisionar as equipes técnicas de infraestrutura (N3 e NOC);
  • Planejar e monitorar a operação contínua dos serviços de TIC;
  • Garantir o cumprimento dos SLAs, segurança da informação e estabilidade da operação;

  • Elaborar relatórios de operação e apoiar processos de auditoria.

Requisitos obrigatórios

O profissional deverá possuir curso superior completo na área de Tecnologia da Informação (TI) , ou curso superior completo em qualquer área , desde que complementado com pós-graduação na área de TI , realizada em instituição reconhecida pelo Ministério da Educação (MEC).

São exigidas as seguintes certificações e formações complementares:

  • Certificação ISO/IEC 27001 ;
  • Certificação ITIL 4 , sendo exigido, no mínimo, o módulo Specialist – Create, Deliver & Support , ou certificação equivalente ou superior da mesma trilha;
  • Certificação HDI – SCTL (Support Center Team Lead) ;
  • Curso de capacitação em sistemas operacionais Windows e Linux .

Além da formação e certificações, o profissional deve comprovar:

  • Experiência mínima de 5 (cinco) anos em atividades técnicas relacionadas à área de TI;
  • Experiência mínima de 3 (três) anos em gestão de projetos e liderança de equipes técnicas .

Adicionalmente, é obrigatória a apresentação de ao menos uma das seguintes certificações reconhecidas na área de gerenciamento de projetos e/ou serviços de TI :

  • PMP – Project Management Professional ;
  • CAPM – Certified Associate in Project Management

description:
Overview

Formação Acadêmica

  • Bacharelado em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Ciência de Dados ou área relacionada.
  • Pós-graduação, Mestrado ou Doutorado é desejável.

Responsabilidades

  • Colaborar com clientes para entender suas necessidades de dados e desenvolver soluções para extrair, transformar, armazenar e exibir dados.
  • Pesquisar sistemas internos para identificar dados disponíveis, sua estrutura, métodos de acesso e otimizar seu uso em sistemas e aplicações.

  • Liderar o desenvolvimento e aprimoramento de pipelines de dados, gerenciando novas solicitações de recursos e comunicando-se com os gerentes do cliente.
  • Desenvolver e manter plataformas para compartilhamento de dados e dashboards.
  • Criar documentação abrangente sobre fontes de dados, métodos de acesso, contatos-chave e outras informações relevantes.
  • Apresentar resultados obtidos para stakeholders em todos os níveis (técnicos e não técnicos) de forma clara e concisa.

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento de software.
  • Experiência na construção e otimização de pipelines de processamento de dados em larga escala e produção, utilizando tecnologias distribuídas.
  • Experiência na configuração e utilização de plataformas de dados baseadas em nuvem, com capacidade de provisionar e configurar recursos.
  • Experiência com Python (preferencial) ou outras linguagens para ciência de dados e análise.
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e SQL.
  • Experiência com bibliotecas de análise de dados (Pandas, NumPy, SciPy, Scikit-learn, etc.).
  • Experiência com bibliotecas de visualização de dados (Tableau Desktop/Server, matplotlib, seaborn, plotly, etc.).
  • Experiência na construção e otimização de pipelines de dados.
  • Experiência com frameworks de processamento de dados distribuídos (ex.: Apache Spark, Apache Flink, MapReduce).
  • Sistemas de gerenciamento de recursos e armazenamento de Big Data (ex.: HDFS, YARN; ou soluções em nuvem como S3, EMR).
  • Ferramentas de orquestração de fluxo de trabalho (ex.: Apache Airflow, Dagster, Prefect).
  • Formatos de lakehouse modernos (ex.: Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, Apache Hudi).
  • Mecanismos de consulta SQL distribuídos para data lakes (ex.: Trino/Presto).
  • Experiência em aquisição e persistência de novas fontes de dados para uso por cientistas de dados e analistas.
  • Experiência no uso de serviços baseados em nuvem (AWS ou GCP) para transferência, processamento e armazenamento de dados.

Idioma

  • Inglês avançado (leitura, escrita, conversação, técnico) para contato diário com parceiros no exterior.

Desejável

  • Conhecimento de protocolos de rede, autenticação, criptografia e comunicação de rede segura.
  • Conhecimento de tecnologias de processamento em tempo real (Kafka, Kinesis ou equivalentes).
  • Governança, segurança e qualidade de dados.
  • Ferramentas de integração de dados (Pentaho, ODI/OWB, SSIS, etc.).
  • Ferramentas de exploração de dados (Jupyter Notebook, iPython, etc.).
  • Padrões de design de software (MVC, MVVM).
  • Conhecimentos de Hadoop, Hive, Cassandra e Kubernetes.
  • Controle de versão de software (Git).

Diversidade e Inclusão

No Atlântico, a diversidade e a inclusão são compromissos. Valorizamos a pluralidade de pensamentos e vivências, promovendo um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e diverso, com oportunidades equitativas e respeito à diversidade cultural, religiosa, étnico-racial, de gênero, de orientação afetivo-sexual e de pessoas com deficiência.

Impacto Social

O Comitê de Diversidade e Inclusão investe em ações de voluntariado com foco em impacto social positivo, apoiando organizações do terceiro setor e projetos que atendem públicos contemplados pelos pilares do Atlântico. Em 2022, lançamos projeto para capacitação de pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade social, com resultados de formação em Lógica de Programação Básica.

Join to apply for the Medical Specialist role at Innodata Inc.

Job Title: Generative AI Associate Analyst (LLM Training – Medical Domain) — Location: Remote — Employment Type: Flexible Contract Role (Part-time, up to 25 hours weekly).

About Innodata: Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company with more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities worldwide. We provide AI technology solutions for a wide range of industries, including financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine. Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees across the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany. By combining advanced ML/AI technologies with a global workforce and a secure infrastructure, we help advance the potential of AI. Innodata offers digital data solutions and easy-to-use platforms.

Role focus : We are seeking professionals with a Master’s or PhD in Medical Microbiology or a closely related biomedical discipline to support the development of large language models (LLMs) in the medical domain. The role involves evaluating AI-generated responses for scientific accuracy, contextual integrity, and clinical relevance in medical microbiology, and providing feedback to improve AI systems used in healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health communication, and biomedical research.

Key Responsibilities

  • Critically assess AI-generated responses on topics including microbial taxonomy, infectious disease mechanisms, host–pathogen interactions, diagnostic microbiology, antimicrobial resistance, and laboratory methodologies.
  • Apply structured annotation to texts, labeling for scientific correctness, terminology accuracy, logical structure, and clinical relevance.
  • Categorize model outputs using domain-specific taxonomies (e.g., pathogen type, disease process, diagnostic method).
  • Create real-world clinical or laboratory scenarios with researchers to design and test prompts, evaluating the model’s reasoning and adaptability to professional contexts (e.g., interpreting culture reports, recommending diagnostic tests, understanding resistance profiles).

Required Qualifications

  • Master’s or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.
  • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).
  • Excellent written communication skills and fluency in English.
  • As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment. The assessment is mandatory & non-billable.

title: Regional Commercial Agronomy Lead - Crossroads Region
description:
Overview

About Pivot Bio:

Fueled by an innovative drive and a deep understanding of microbiology, genomics, crop nutrition and agriculture, Pivot Bio is pioneering game-changing advances in fertilizer technology. Our first commercial product harnesses the power of naturally-occurring microbes, modern gene editing and application technologies to provide nitrogen to crops. We are dedicated to providing new solutions for farmers to improve yield as they work to help feed the world’s growing population. Read/Hear more about Pivot Bio on Forbes or PBS News Hour.

We are seeking a Regional Commercial Agronomy Lead to manage, support, and lead a team of Commercial Agronomists on a regional level, while also providing agronomy support for an assigned portion of the region. As a key member of the Commercial team, the RCAL leads regional agronomy efforts for product performance data generation and sharing, seller agronomic and technical product training, and on-farm grower support. Pivot Bio products aim to deliver a more consistent and reliable source of nitrogen to crops and our Commercial Agronomy team strives to be industry leading nitrogen advisors. The ideal candidate will reside within this region.

Responsibilities

  • Provide regional leadership and management of Commercial Agronomists in geographical area.
  • Lead technical product knowledge, nitrogen management, customer support, and agronomy information training and development of the assigned team of Commercial Agronomists.
  • Lead commercial agronomy activites such as seller training, product demonstrations, and customer support for an assigned portion of the region.
  • Provide supplemental or next level sales and agronomy support and training for agronomists in the region. Manage current and next generation product demonstration trialing and performance data generation efforts for the region.
  • Support and facilitate commercial activities including regional product placement suggestions, regional marketing support, and regional sales staff trainings.
  • Collaborate with Regional Sales Leader on regional strategy for distribution development and sales support.
  • Lead agronomy training and trialing efforts with regional Retail distribution partners.
  • Manage key 3rd party relationships and trialing efforts within region.
  • Assist sales teams with regional sales representative trainings and customer facing events to provide technical product knowledge and agronomy support.
  • Develop and provide regional agronomy research summary materials that can be used to support product management, positioning, field sales, and training.
  • Work in partnership with the regional Product Development team to characterize and demonstrate the advantages of new commercial and pre-commercial products.
  • Collaborate with Product Development regarding product testing and validation efforts with university organizations and other third-party partnerships.
  • Regularly integrate emerging technology tools for evaluation of products as well as grower demonstrations and support.

Competencies

  • Demonstrated ability to manage and lead a team of individual contributors.
  • Strong background in agronomy or related field with a solid understanding of agricultural crops and inputs within the assigned geography.
  • Experience with fertilizer and fertility knowledge of products, applications, practices, and crop needs.
  • Fluent in understanding and ability to educate on nitrogen and nitrogen management.
  • Ability to engage/present in customer field days, meetings, as well as certain company events.
  • Strong background in field sales training with experience in technical knowledge transfer to both professional agronomists and customers or sales representatives.

description:
Visão Geral

Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!

A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicas e Médicos Especialistas em Medicina e Saúde da Família e Comunidade . Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.

A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.

Você realizará atendimento de orientação médica telefônica através de uma abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos.

Descrição das Atividades

  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.
  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.
  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde relativos a diferentes gêneros ou grupos etários.
  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.
  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.
  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em MEDICINA DA FAMILIA, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.

description:
Overview

Country Operations Manager – LATAM

Job Type: Full-time contract

Trantor Inc. is a global technology services and consulting company headquartered in Palo Alto, California, with delivery centers across the USA, Canada, and India. We partner with Fortune 500 companies and high-growth enterprises to drive digital transformation through Product Engineering, Cloud Enablement, Data & AI Solutions, Automation, and Customer Success Services. At Trantor, we thrive in a collaborative, agile, and people-first environment.

Why Join Trantor?

Trantor offers the opportunity to work on diverse, cutting-edge projects in a culture that values innovation, continuous learning, and collaboration. Enjoy the flexibility of a remote role while contributing to impactful initiatives in a truly global organization.

Opportunity Summary

We are seeking an experienced and results-driven Country Manager – LATAM to lead and scale our operations across the region. This role is 80% operations-focused , with responsibility for resource management, workforce planning, employee engagement, HR, HR compliance, and strategic growth . The remaining 20% requires technical acumen to manage tech people, understand how tech operations are run, and participate in technical discussions with clients.

Why Join Us?

title: Tech writer senior
description:
Quem somos nós?
Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.
Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios, exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor.
Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!
Antes De Avançarmos, é Importante Você Saber Que

  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas.
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.
O que buscamos?
Estamos em busca de um/uma Tech Writer para fazer parte de nosso movimento. Quem ocupar esta posição será responsável por traduzir soluções técnicas em conteúdos claros, completos e reutilizáveis, garantindo que times internos, clientes e usuários tenham documentação precisa para tomada de decisão, desenvolvimento, operação e suporte. Você atuará junto a engenharia, produto e negócios para padronizar linguagem, organizar conhecimento e acelerar entregas.
Como será seu dia-a-dia?
  • Levantar informações com especialistas (engenharia, produto, CX) e transformar em documentação clara e objetiva
  • Produzir e manter documentação de APIs (REST/GraphQL), arquiteturas, playbooks/runbooks, procedimentos de operação e guides de onboarding
  • Estruturar conteúdo em Docs-as-Code (Markdown/AsciiDoc), versionando em Git e publicando via pipelines (ex.: Docusaurus, MkDocs)
  • Criar e atualizar modelos/templatizações, glossário e padrões de estilo para garantir consistência entre projetos
  • Elaborar diagramas (Mermaid/PlantUML/Draw.io) que expliquem fluxos, integrações e componentes
  • Revisar tecnicamente conteúdos produzidos por terceiros (engenharia/fornecedores) e garantir acurácia e aderência ao padrão
  • Mapear jornadas de usuários internos/externos e escrever how-tos, troubleshooting e FAQs
  • Medir a utilização/impacto da documentação (analytics, feedbacks) e conduzir ciclos de melhoria contínua
  • Coordenar calendário editorial e priorizar backlog de documentação alinhado ao roadmap de produto/projeto
Para Cumprir Esse Desafio, Você Precisa Ter
  • Experiência de mais de 03 anos comprovada como Tech Writer
  • Vivência com Markdown/AsciiDoc, Git/GitHub/GitLab e publicação estática (ex.: Docusaurus, MkDocs)
  • Conhecimento de boas práticas de versionamento
  • Noções sólidas de APIs REST, OpenAPI/Swagger e integrações entre serviços
  • Capacidade de entrevistar fontes técnicas e transformar complexidade em clareza
  • Organização, atenção a detalhes e habilidade de trabalhar com múltiplos stakeholders
Você Irá Se Destacar Se
  • Tiver experiência com Docs-as-Code avançado (linting, testes, preview em PR, verificação de links)
  • Tiver familiaridade com Docusaurus/MkDocs, Antora, Sphinx, Notion/Confluence, Postman e Stoplight
  • Já tiver utilizado LLMs/IA para apoio editorial (rastreabilidade, revisão, sugestões de estrutura)

description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. We were founded in 2017 out of a conviction that the iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different. Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients.

Our team has been responsible for billions of dollars in trackable revenue across e-commerce marketplace, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs under management. We accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high-impact digital strategies that unlock gateways to revenue growth, transform marketing operations, and prioritize profitability. Darkroom has evolved from a boutique design agency to one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and has received recognition by Forbes 30 Under 30 for our founders’ contribution in Marketing & Advertising.

About The Role

Editor at Darkroom: your primary duty is to develop and assist in the development of marketing collateral, including video content and organic content. Editors add value to client work through native content and strategies. The ideal candidate is passionate about using editing skills to tell compelling stories and help our customers grow their businesses.

This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and is open to candidates based in Brazil, Portugal, and Spain.

Who You Are

  • Experience creating platform native content (including video content and organic content), especially IG Reels, Meta ads, and TikTok viral video campaigns
  • Exceptional time management and organization skills with the ability to manage deliverables across multiple brands
  • Strong Motion Graphics/Graphic Design/Typography skills
  • Proficient in Adobe Premiere Pro + Final Cut Pro X (FCPX)
  • Working knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite (especially Media Encoder, After Effects, Premiere, and Photoshop)
  • Familiarity with broadcast finishing workflows (mix, color, VFX, conform, online)
  • Familiarity working in a networked server environment
  • Strong technical knowledge of codecs and transcoding practices
  • Strong time management skills and ability to work in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong communication skills
  • Proficient with animation/graphic design

What You'll Do

  • You will be editing UGC-style videos in a variety of content formats
  • Develop and execute thumb-stopping social media video edits, layer audio seamlessly and overlay text that drives key brand messaging
  • Brainstorm inventive edits and hooks that drive engagement, leverage new formats
  • Stay current on all social media platforms, ad offerings, content publishers, tools, trends, and best practices
  • Be a creative collaborator: have the ability to be the voice of the brand and the influencer to create content authentic for all channels
  • Be comfortable using video editing software, editing audio, and taking editing direction in a fast-paced environment
  • Provide accessible content that includes closed captioning, voiceover, and overlay text in a variety of aspect ratios
  • Set up projects for edit staff
  • Ingesting and logging footage
  • Work in tandem with edit staff to meet deadlines
  • Editing lower-level projects
  • Maintaining media storage (hard drives, servers, GDrive)
  • Mastering deliverables and archiving projects
  • Assisting senior staff with edit and administrative needs
  • Versioning various aspect ratios of completed edits
  • Maintaining all software and assets (Mac OSX, server OS, frame.io, Vimeo, shared assets)
  • Coordinating and troubleshooting edit equipment
  • Reporting to the Post-Production Supervisor and Producers; produce high-quality video edits spanning various media platforms as requested
  • Performance creative editing in collaboration with the performance marketing team reviewing ad analytics/performance

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players who want to build something great. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable. We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics .

Location: Remote-first culture with hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philadelphia, Lisbon, Sao Paulo, and Barcelona. Parental leave benefits support new parents. Our agency emphasizes cross-functional collaboration and opportunities for growth through total immersion in diverse services.

RD Station - Pessoa Cientista de Dados Sênior - IA Generativa

Quer fazer parte de um time que cria oportunidades e potencializa a evolução?

Como alcançamos tudo isso?

Através de um time de mais de 12 mil pessoas que, juntas, oferecem soluções, produtos e educam o mercado. Formamos um ecossistema que se estende por todo o país e que ultrapassa fronteiras, integrando e conectando negócios. Sabemos que o crescimento acontece de gente para gente, e é isso que nos move.

Nosso jeito de ser:

Potencializamos a evolução: Transformamos ideias em realidade em uma empresa dinâmica e inovadora. Fazer parte deste time, significa aprender, criar e evoluir.

Bem-Estar Integral : Buscamos o bem-estar integral de cada pessoa colaboradora, por meio de ações e benefícios que viabilizam recursos de autocuidado através de 5 pilares: Emocional, Financeiro, Físico, Ocupacional e Social.

Pluralidade : A diversidade faz parte de quem a gente é. Reconhecidos entre as Melhores Empresas para Trabalhar no Brasil, promovemos a inclusão e o pertencimento de forma ativa. Nossa expertise é humana e viva, e através dela, acolhemos e empoderamos pessoas dentro e fora da empresa.

Seu desafio no time

Você fará parte da área de Ciência de Dados da RD Station, contribuindo para iniciativas estratégicas que integram análise avançada, modelagem preditiva e inovação tecnológica. Atuará no ciclo completo de projetos de dados — desde a exploração e preprocessamento até a entrega de modelos escaláveis —, com oportunidade de aplicar conhecimentos em IA generativa para resolver problemas complexos em produtos SaaS.

Suas principais entregas

  • Desenvolver e implementar modelos preditivos, sistemas de recomendação e análises estatísticas para otimizar produtos e processos;
  • Aplicar técnicas de IA generativa em casos específicos, como personalização de conteúdo ou automação de tarefas, integrando-as a soluções tradicionais de machine learning;
  • Garantir reprodutibilidade e qualidade nas entregas, utilizando boas práticas de versionamento, testes e documentação;
  • Colaborar com engenheiros de dados e produto para estruturar pipelines robustos e alinhar modelos às necessidades do negócio;
  • Traduzir requisitos técnicos em insights acionáveis, mantendo equilíbrio entre inovação e viabilidade operacional.
  • Domínio em análise exploratória, modelagem estatística e construção de modelos de machine learning tradicionais (supervisionado e não supervisionado);
  • Experiência prática com IA generativa, incluindo LLMs e aplicações em cenários reais (ex: fine-tuning, RAG, avaliação de outputs);
  • Conhecimento avançado em Python e bibliotecas como Pandas, NumPy e Scikit-learn, além de familiaridade com frameworks de IA generativa (ex: LangChain, LlamaIndex);
  • Conhecimento em engenharia de dados (SQL, manipulação de dados estruturados e não estruturados) e deployment de modelos em produção;
  • Capacidade de traduzir problemas de negócio em soluções técnicas, com foco em escalabilidade e métricas claras de sucesso.

Será considerado um diferencial

  • Experiência em MLOps (MLflow, Airflow) e infraestrutura em nuvem (AWS, GCP, Azure);
  • Vivência em produtos SaaS B2B com alto volume de dados ou complexidade técnica;
  • Habilidade para comunicar resultados técnicos a stakeholders não técnicos;
  • Participação em projetos ponta a ponta, desde a concepção até o monitoramento pós-deploy;
  • Perfil que valorize a ciência por trás dos dados e saiba equilibrar inovação com pragmatismo.

  • Strategic Thinking - Ability to think ahead and align short-term actions with long-term goals, including scaling performance.
  • Sales Acumen - Skills to pitch ad solutions effectively, negotiate deals, and close partnerships with publishers or advertisers.
  • Results-Oriented - Strong drive to achieve and exceed KPIs and revenue targets.
  • Negotiation Skills - Confidence in negotiating with clients, vendors, and partners to secure the best outcomes for the business.
  • Resilience - Ability to handle challenges and setbacks while maintaining motivation and a positive attitude.
  • Data Visualization - Skills to create clear and impactful reports or dashboards to communicate performance and insights effectively.

Overview

MonetizeMore is a leading ad-tech company dedicated to empowering digital publishers to maximize their ad revenue through innovative technology and strategic partnerships. Our cutting-edge platform optimizes ad layouts, leverages header bidding, and integrates advanced analytics to drive superior results for publishers worldwide. Headquartered in Canada with a strong presence in the APAC region, we’re looking for a dynamic Commissioned Sales Representative to join our high-performing team and help publishers thrive in the digital advertising ecosystem.

Job Overview

We are looking for a Media Buyer & Ad Operations Success Manager who excels in both programmatic/media buying and ad tech operations. This role is critical in ensuring the success of our advertising campaigns by optimizing media investments, managing ad tech infrastructure, and driving performance through data-driven strategies.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience in media buying (paid social, programmatic, search, or video) and a deep understanding of ad serving, tracking, and campaign troubleshooting. You will bridge the gap between media execution and technical ad ops, ensuring seamless campaign delivery and maximizing ROI.

Key Responsibilities

  • Media Buying & Optimization:
    • Plan, execute, and optimize performance-driven media buys across platforms (Meta, Google, DSPs, etc.).
    • Manage budgets, bids, and targeting strategies to maximize campaign performance.
    • Conduct A/B testing, audience segmentation, and funnel optimization.
  • Ad Operations & Technical Management:
    • Oversee ad trafficking, tag implementation (Google Tag Manager, pixels, etc.), and QA.
    • Troubleshoot discrepancies in delivery, tracking, or attribution.
    • Collaborate with internal teams and vendors to resolve technical issues.
  • Performance Analysis & Reporting:
    • Monitor KPIs (CTR, CPA, ROAS) and provide actionable insights.
    • Generate reports and present findings to stakeholders.
    • Ensure alignment between media spend and business objectives.
  • Client & Stakeholder Success:
    • Act as a trusted advisor to internal teams or clients on best practices.
    • Proactively identify opportunities for campaign improvement.

What We're Looking For

  • Analytical Thinking - Ability to interpret data, identify trends, and make data-driven decisions.
  • Technical Proficiency - Familiarity with digital advertising tools and platforms like Google Ad Manager, WordPress, GAM 360, traffic acquisition tools such as Active Campaign and header bidding solutions.
  • Problem-Solving Skills - Resourceful in identifying issues, troubleshooting errors, and finding effective solutions.
  • Attention to Detail - Precision in setting up campaigns, implementing ad tags, or managing publisher configurations to ensure optimal outcomes.
  • Communication Skills - Clarity in conveying technical details, results, and strategies to stakeholders with varying levels of understanding.
  • Client-Centric Mindset - Strong focus on understanding client needs and providing personalized solutions to maximize client satisfaction.
  • Knowledge of Ad Metrics - Understanding of key ad metrics like CPM, CPC, CTR, RPM, and ad yield optimization strategies.
  • Strategic Thinking - Ability to think ahead and align short-term actions with long-term goals, including scaling performance.
  • Sales Acumen - Skills to pitch ad solutions effectively, negotiate deals, and close partnerships with publishers or advertisers.
  • Results-Oriented - Strong drive to achieve and exceed KPIs and revenue targets.
  • Negotiation Skills - Confidence in negotiating with clients, vendors, and partners to secure the best outcomes for the business.
  • Resilience - Ability to handle challenges and setbacks while maintaining motivation and a positive attitude.
  • Data Visualization - Skills to create clear and impactful reports or dashboards to communicate performance and insights effectively.
  • AI Fluency - Understanding and practical application of AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, data enrichment tools, automated workflows) to enhance productivity, decision-making, and campaign performance.

If you think you are a good fit to join the MonetizeMore team, please fill out the application. Also, give specific reasons on what sets you apart. We hire individuals, not robots so don’t be afraid to show a little personality ;)

title: ENFERMEIRO(A) COMERCIAL
description:
O(A) Enfermeiro(a) Comercial deve atuar na condução do processo de venda direta ao consumidor do novo portfólio de serviços da Clínica Florence, apresentando soluções de cuidado a pacientes e familiares. Garantir uma experiência positiva ao longo da jornada do cliente, incluindo acolhimento, orientação, conversão e acompanhamento pós-venda.

  1. Receber pacientes e familiares que buscam a Clínica Florence, espontaneamente ou por indicação médica. Apresentar estrutura, modelo de cuidado, diferenciais e equipe, conduzindo visitas guiadas (presenciais ou virtuais);
  2. Criar e manter vínculo com pacientes e familiares pré, durante e pós internação. Engajar nos produtos complementares, apoiando a transição de internação e pós-Florence;
  3. Atuar junto à equipe multiprofissional para entender o plano de cuidado, acompanhar o processo de alta e garantir que as necessidades do paciente no pós-alta sejam mapeadas;
  4. Ser ponto focal de contato para pacientes egressos, especialmente os que ainda não estão inseridos em programas de navegação;
  5. Alimentar sistemas de CRM com histórico, status de negociações, registros de contato e percepções;
  6. Ser responsável pelos processos de internação particular em conjunto com a área comercial;
  7. Contribuir com a gestão de comunidades de potenciais clientes;
  8. Graduação completa em Enfermagem com registro ativo no COREN;
  9. Desejável pós-graduação em Gestão Hospitalar , Negócios em Saúde ou Experiência do Paciente ;
  10. Desejável conhecimento sobre Cuidados paliativos, reabilitação, transição de cuidados e dependência funcional;
  11. Desejável conhecimento sobre Linhas de cuidado para idosos, pacientes com sequelas neurológicas, AVC, pós-operatórios complexos;
  12. Experiência em técnicas de vendas consultivas , negociação e CRM ;
  13. Benefícios oferecidos: Plano de Saúde e Odontológico, treinamentos técnicos e comportamentais específicos, Biblioteca Comunitária, Clube de Benefícios com descontos, espaço de repouso climatizado, refeições balanceadas, copa do colaborador com frutas, lanches e café, ações de bem-estar, programas de reconhecimento como "Passaporte do Cuidador", entre outros.

A Florence é um hospital de transição dedicado ao cuidado de pacientes provenientes de hospitais gerais, que possuem diagnóstico definido e ainda requerem alta intensidade de cuidado. Atendemos pacientes para reabilitação intensiva e cuidados paliativos de fim de vida.

Representa um marco no tratamento humanizado, com instalações projetadas para criar uma atmosfera mais pessoal e acolhedora, possibilitando maior interação entre o paciente e seus familiares. Por isso, entre um ambiente com cuidados especializados ou com carinho e atenção, escolha os dois: escolha a Clínica Florence.

Clínica Florence. Mais cuidado, mais vida.

  • Conhecimento em linguagens para manipulação de dados como Python e JavaScript .
  • Mentalidade analítica, proativa e uma grande disposição para compartilhar conhecimento e aprender continuamente.

title: Inbound Sales Representative
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Inbound Sales Representative role at Toptal .

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary

Our Inbound Sales Representatives connect and engage with prospective clients who originate from inbound leads. They seek new business opportunities by connecting with, and developing relationships with, potential customers and guiding prospective clients throughout the required sales stages. To excel in this position, you need to effectively communicate and collaborate with clients, ensuring they understand the value of our services and how Toptal can support their goals. Our ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, is hungry to exceed sales quotas, and strives to go above and beyond. If you are passionate about sales, innately driven, and results-oriented, this is the perfect opportunity for you to launch your sales career.

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities

  • Sales Cycle Management: You will be the initial face of Toptal and support our clients through the required sales stages. As the first point of contact and the initial ‘face’ of Toptal for new clients, you will be responsible for moving these clients forward in the sales process, starting with regularly conducting sales calls. You will be responsible for accurately articulating the benefit of Toptal to potential clients in these calls and managing deal cycles from discovery through close.
  • Client Experience: You will execute a customer-centric approach across all client interactions during pre-defined working hours. You will build rapport with prospective clients, which will require researching clients before outreach and staying on top of industry trends and Toptal competitors.
  • Collaboration with Team Members: You will collaborate with your team to promptly respond to high-volume inbound client inquiries. Communicating via Zoom and Slack is critical to maintaining a high level of collaboration and clear communication within the team.
  • Growth and Development: Our SMB sales team members always look to improve individually and as a team. Being open to and implementing feedback will be critical to achieving success in this role at Toptal.

Qualifications and Job Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree is required.
  • The ideal candidate has 1-3 years of B2B sales experience (e.g., Account Executive, Inside Sales, Outside Sales Representative, Account Representative, or related title).
  • Software or tech-related sales experience and education are a plus.
  • Be attentive to client needs. You will be required to be fully available during your working hours to take client calls.
  • You are client-centric. You will be working with prospective clients daily, uncovering and resolving clients’ issues through value-based selling.
  • Have a “will-to-win” attitude. You’re looking to not only meet but exceed your quota and are naturally competitive. We provide a base salary plus uncapped commission and want our Client Advisors to make the most out of it!
  • You’re a “learn-it-all.” We are looking for someone who is always looking to grow, strives for improvement, and constantly seeks feedback from peers/leaders. Even as an individual contributor, you seek to share and gain knowledge from those around you.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with your team members.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work and thrive in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts. We move quickly, so having exceptional time management skills and the ability to manage a high volume of clients is key to being successful in this role.
  • You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

description:
Join to apply for the Video Editor role at Darkroom

About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. We were founded in 2017 out of a conviction that the iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different. Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients. Our team has been responsible for billions of dollars in trackable revenue across e-commerce marketplaces, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs under management. Using research aggregated across these engagements, we accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high-impact digital strategies that unlock gateways to revenue growth, transform marketing operations, and prioritize profitability. What started as a boutique design agency evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000), one of the most successful results-driven performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos), and earned recognition by Forbes 30 Under 30 for our founders’ contribution in Marketing & Advertising (Forbes).

About The Role

As an Editor at Darkroom, your primary duty will be to develop and assist in the development of marketing collateral, including video content and organic content. Our Editors add immense value to our client's work through native content and strategies. The ideal candidate is someone who is passionate about using their editing skills to tell a compelling story and help our customers grow their businesses.

This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and is open to candidates based in Brazil, Portugal, and Spain.

Who You Are

  • Experience creating platform native content (including video content and organic content), especially IG Reels, Meta ads, and TikTok viral video campaigns
  • Exceptional time management and organization skills with the ability to manage deliverables across an array of brands
  • Strong Motion Graphics/ Graphic Design/ Typography skills required
  • Proficient in Adobe Premiere Pro + FCPX
  • Working knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite (especially Media Encoder, After Effects, Premiere, and Photoshop)
  • Familiarity with broadcast finishing workflows (mix, color, VFX, conform, online)
  • Familiarity working in a networked server environment
  • Strong technical knowledge of codecs and transcoding practices
  • Strong time management skills and ability to work in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong communication skills
  • Proficient with animation/ graphic design preferred

What You'll Do

  • You will be editing UGC-style videos in a variety of content formats
  • Develop and execute thumb-stopping social media video edits, layer audio seamlessly and overlay text that drives key brand messaging
  • Brainstorm inventive edits and hooks that drive engagement, leverage new formats
  • Stay current on all social media platforms, ad offerings, content publishers, tools, trends, and best practices
  • Be a creative collaborator: Have the ability to be the voice of the brand and the influencer to create content that is authentic and powerful for all channels
  • Be comfortable using video editing software, editing audio, and taking editing direction, while working in a fast pace environment
  • Provide accessible content that includes closed captioning, voiceover, and overlay text in a variety of aspect ratios
  • Setting up projects for edit staff
  • Ingesting and logging footage
  • Working in tandem with edit staff to meet deadlines
  • Editing lower-level projects
  • Maintaining media storage (hard drives, servers, GDrive)
  • Mastering deliverables and archiving projects
  • Assisting senior staff with edit and administrative needs
  • Versioning various aspect ratios of completed edits
  • Maintaining all software and assets (Mac OSX, server operating system, frame.io, Vimeo, shared assets)
  • Coordinating and troubleshooting edit equipment
  • Reporting to the Post-Production Supervisor and Producers, the AE will upon request create high-quality video edits that will span various media platforms
  • Performance creative editing (collaborating with the performance marketing team in reviewing ad analytics/performance)

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable. We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics. If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote-first culture with a strong community base. With Hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, Sao Paulo, and Barcelona!
  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work-life balance.
  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross-functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. About The Role

We are seeking highly qualified professionals with (Master's or PhD) in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs). As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will play a critical role in shaping how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, with a specific focus on microbiological sciences. This role involves evaluating AI-generated responses for scientific accuracy, contextual integrity, and clinical relevance within the field of medical microbiology. Your feedback and annotations will inform the improvement of AI systems used in healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health communication, and biomedical research.

  • Critically assess AI-generated responses in topics including microbial taxonomy, infectious disease mechanisms, host–pathogen interactions, diagnostic microbiology, antimicrobial resistance, and laboratory methodologies.

  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.

For internal stakeholders, the role will streamline project administration, update incentive websites and equipment catalogs, and handle data acquisition and reporting. This role also involves collaborating with internal teams and engaging with industry participants and funders to maintain stakeholder relationships and support the overall success of CALSTART initiatives.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Lead dealer education initiative and involvement, training dealers and purchasers on participating in the incentive projects (e.g. responding to inquiry emails, assisting with or escalating Salesforce technical issues, preparing presentations to inform how the voucher processes work, etc.)

  • Use CALSTART CRM (Customer Relationship Management) systems such as Salesforce and Monday.com to keep and maintain records and perform and track daily tasks.
  • Lead the development of standard operating procedures for internal processes and using project management tools to further develop enhancements of the program as it pertains to reporting, program funding launches, and program development.
  • Support organizing and attending project-related workshops, events, forums, presentations, and webinars, such as drafting announcement emails and presentation slides, coordinating with communications managing webinars, and strategize communication tactics for workgroups and webinars
  • Assist with other tasks or other CALSTART initiatives as requested by other teams/departments

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in project management, with strong skills in timeline development, resource allocation, budget management, risk assessment, and cross-functional team coordination.
  • 1-2 years of experience with Salesforce, including skills in custom object creation, workflow automation, report generation, data management, and user administration.
  • Project management experience demonstrating proficiency in scope definition, team leadership, quality assurance, and stakeholder engagement.
  • Experience with Salesforce, including skills in data integration, process automation, dashboard creation, and system customization.
  • Experience supporting diverse stakeholders, with skills in effective communication, conflict resolution, needs assessment, and tailored solution delivery.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage and streamline administrative workflows, with skills in process optimization, documentation management, and workflow automation.
  • Proven ability to work effectively with internal teams and external stakeholders, utilizing collaboration tools, stakeholder management techniques, cross-functional coordination, and conflict resolution strategies.
  • Bachelor's degree in Environmental Science, Public Policy, Business Administration, or related fields, with skills in data analysis, project management, policy development, and stakeholder communication.

Desired Qualifications

  • Experience in sales, with a demonstrated ability to build and maintain strong relationships with external stakeholders, fostering collaboration and mutual support.
  • Experience in the Zero-Emission Vehicle (ZEV) industry or related initiatives, showcasing a strong understanding of industry-specific trends and regulations.

Salary: $72,000 - $85,760 a year

Join to apply for the Medical Specialist role at Innodata Inc.

Job Title: Generative AI Associate Analyst (LLM Training – Medical Domain)
Location: Remote
Employment Type: Flexible Contract Role (Part-time, up to 25 hours weekly)

Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine. By combining advanced machine learning and AI technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we are helping usher in the promise of AI. We are seeking highly qualified professionals with (Master's or PhD) in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs).

As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will play a critical role in shaping how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, with a specific focus on microbiological sciences. This role involves evaluating AI-generated responses for scientific accuracy, contextual integrity, and clinical relevance within the field of medical microbiology. Your feedback and annotations will inform the improvement of AI systems used in healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health communication, and biomedical research.

  • Create real-world clinical or laboratory scenarios with researchers to design and test prompts to assess the model's reasoning and adaptability to professional contexts (e.g., interpreting culture reports, recommending diagnostic tests, understanding resistance profiles).

Required Qualifications

  • Master's or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.
